featured_reviews.review_text:
HONEST DETAILED REVIEW.

(Refer to Image)
*I had shoulder length pre-colored brown hair with three inches of grown black roots and lighter ends.*

Went there after checking Google Reviews but sigh, talking about them at the end of this review.

8. Hair color not done as requested.
9. Sink and seating for hair-wash not appropriate, neck hurts and scalp touches the sink drainage.
10. High temperature used on hair dryer, and too close to the scalp. Scalp was burning.
11. Heat protectant or some other serum was applied only at the front hair strands.
12. Color uneven, with parts looking highly bleached and poorly toned though no bleach was used.
13. Staff made excuses for poor results, blaming hair damage.
14. Hair poorly colored, with significant damage even on my healthy grown out hair.
15. Staff complained about payment amount still and tried to sell additional services.
16. Forced to record video for social media despite refusing.
17. Asked to review on Google on the spot.

‘Staff’ includes the owner and another lady. ^
Exploited and disappointed with service but hair doesn’t look bad, the lady worked on my hair for a while and owner was sweet? And claimed to use quality products so two stars regardless. Maybe poor work is done so you come and get more of their treatments for the fixing as they mentioned a few customers who constantly come visit for expensive treatments for the hair damage done after services in this salon.

Advising all to be cautious and seek trusted services. Most reviews are probably by people who’ve most certainly done basic services, had low expectations, by family/friends, or were asked to give a review on the spot like me. Always find trusted services and stick to them. We all learn!
